llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper for a public news/search API (agenttimes.live), asks only that curl be available, and does not request unrelated credentials or install components.

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: make curl requests to agenttimes.live for news and web search. No credentials or installs are required for the free endpoints. If you plan to use paid endpoints, only provide an API key in the X-API-Key header as documented and be cautious with any micropayment (x402) flows — check the payment provider and confirm you are comfortable transacting on Base. Remember network calls expose the queries and your IP to the service, so avoid sending sensitive secrets or internal URLs in queries. If you need higher assurance, review the provider's privacy/policies or test queries through a proxy first.
